name: brand-guidelines

summary.en: Applies Anthropic’s own brand colors and typography to artifacts; useful mainly as an example of packaging a brand guide as a skill.
summary.zh: 把 Anthropic 自家的品牌色和字体应用到产出物上；主要价值在于示范如何把品牌规范做成 Skill。

upstreamDescription: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.
